subject: ap-microeconomics
definition: A tax charged on each unit of a specific good
zhExplanation: 对每单位特定商品征收的税，会使供给曲线向上移动并产生无谓损失。
misconceptions: The seller always pays the whole tax || The burden depends on elasticity
apExample: An excise tax on gasoline raises the price buyers pay and lowers the price sellers keep.

definition: ATP synthesis powered by the flow of protons down their gradient through ATP synthase
